- [FACT] The official language of Argentina is Spanish.
- [FACT] Spanish is spoken by the vast majority of people in Argentina.
- [FACT] Spanish is the language used in schools, government, and the media in Argentina.
- [FACT] There are small communities of people in Argentina who speak other languages, including Italian, German, and French.
- [FACT] Spanish is the predominant language in Argentina.
